reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Washington
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: "Is it specified for what reason a tenant can request that the issuance of a writ be stayed?"
    Statute encoded: WA Rev. Code (RCW) 59.18.410 (2021)
*/

% -----------------------------
% Basic list helper (no modules)
% -----------------------------
list_member(X, [X|_]) :- !.
list_member(X, [_|T]) :- list_member(X, T).

% -----------------------------
% Scenario facts (question's factual statement)
% -----------------------------
scenario_state(washington).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The scenario is a meta-question: we model that a tenant is asking whether the law
% specifies reasons/grounds for requesting a stay of a writ of restitution.
scenario_tenant(tenant1).
scenario_tenant_requests_information_about_stay_reasons(tenant1).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario statement holds (as required).
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(washington),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_tenant(Tenant),
    scenario_tenant_requests_information_about_stay_reasons(Tenant).

% -----------------------------
% Statute translation: RCW 59.18.410 (2021)
% -----------------------------

/*
  RCW 59.18.410(3)(a) (2021):
  In nonpayment-of-rent restitution judgment context, court may stay the writ
  "upon good cause" and on fair/just terms; court considers enumerated factors.
*/

% Grounds/reason explicitly specified for a tenant to request a stay under subsection (3):
statute_rcw_59_18_410_reason_to_request_stay(washington, 2021, good_cause_3a) :- !.
% Grounds/reason explicitly specified for a tenant to request an ex parte stay under subsection (4):
statute_rcw_59_18_410_reason_to_request_stay(washington, 2021, immediate_or_irreparable_harm_4) :- !.

% RCW 59.18.410(3)(a)(i)-(vii) factors the court must consider when deciding "good cause".
statute_rcw_59_18_410_3a_factor(washington, 2021, willful_or_intentional_default_or_failure_to_pay_rent) :- !.
statute_rcw_59_18_410_3a_factor(washington, 2021, nonpayment_caused_by_exigent_circumstances_beyond_tenant_control_not_likely_to_recur) :- !.
statute_rcw_59_18_410_3a_factor(washington, 2021, tenant_ability_to_timely_pay_judgment) :- !.
statute_rcw_59_18_410_3a_factor(washington, 2021, tenant_payment_history) :- !.
statute_rcw_59_18_410_3a_factor(washington, 2021, tenant_substantial_compliance_with_rental_agreement) :- !.
statute_rcw_59_18_410_3a_factor(washington, 2021, hardship_on_tenant_if_evicted) :- !.
statute_rcw_59_18_410_3a_factor(washington, 2021, conduct_related_to_other_notices_last_six_months) :- !.

% Collect the factors into a list (deterministic list construction).
statute_rcw_59_18_410_3a_factors_list(washington, 2021, Factors) :-
    Factors = [
        willful_or_intentional_default_or_failure_to_pay_rent,
        nonpayment_caused_by_exigent_circumstances_beyond_tenant_control_not_likely_to_recur,
        tenant_ability_to_timely_pay_judgment,
        tenant_payment_history,
        tenant_substantial_compliance_with_rental_agreement,
        hardship_on_tenant_if_evicted,
        conduct_related_to_other_notices_last_six_months
    ],
    !.

% RCW 59.18.410(4) (2021): ex parte stay requires certain showings in a declaration.
% We encode the key "reason" component: immediate or irreparable harm if immediate stay not granted.
statute_rcw_59_18_410_4_requires_declaration_elements(washington, 2021, Elements) :-
    Elements = [
        good_faith_efforts_to_notify_other_party_or_explain_why_notice_not_provided,
        describe_immediate_or_irreparable_harm_if_no_immediate_stay,
        court_requires_service_of_order_and_motion_in_manner_likely_to_give_notice
    ],
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Reasoning layer
% -----------------------------

% The legal question we must answer: does the statute specify reasons/grounds for a tenant to request a stay?
% We treat "specified reasons" as: there exists at least one enumerated reason/ground in the statute text.
law_specifies_reason_for_tenant_to_request_stay_of_writ(State, Year) :-
    statute_rcw_59_18_410_reason_to_request_stay(State, Year, _Reason),
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Final answer predicate
% -----------------------------
housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    law_specifies_reason_for_tenant_to_request_stay_of_writ(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% -----------------------------
main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it specified for what reason a tenant can request that the issuance of a writ be stayed?
